titles.title: Master Sergeant Roy P. Benavidez VA Clinic Act of 2026
Master Sergeant Roy P. Benavidez VA Clinic Act of 2026
To designate the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Victoria, Texas, as the "Master Sergeant Roy P. Benavidez VA Clinic".

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Veterans' Affairs.
